PARKS AND RECREATION COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, MAY 21, 2026
  2800 N. STUDEBAKER ROAD
  DR. THOMAS J. CLARK COMMUNITY CENTER, 9:00 AM

Susan Redfield, Chair  Sharleen Higa, Commissioner
Silissa Uriarte Smith, Vice Chair  Robert Livingstone, Commissioner
Cory Allen, Commissioner  Kasey Schoen, Commissioner
Christopher Chavez, Commissioner

Stephen Scott, Director
Jennifer Roberts, Executive Assistant

  Members of the public have the option to submit online and email public comments to
  christine.amaya@longbeach.gov

 CALL TO ORDER

 ROLL CALL

 PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

 PRESENTATIONS

 Employee of the Month

 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  26-54952  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Parks and Recreation
  Commission meeting of Thursday, April 16, 2026 and the Parks and Recreation
  Commission Special Meeting of Thursday, April 16, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 2.  26-54953  Recommendation to receive and file an update regarding Drake Chavez Park as it
  relates to the Department of Parks, Recreation and Marine.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 3.  26-54954  Recommendation to consider approval of the fee waiver requests outlined in
  Attachment “A” in accordance with the Fee Waiver policy.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 4.  26-55054  Recommendation to authorize the Director of Parks, Recreation and Marine, or
  management designee, to execute the Personal Services and Instruction
  Agreements and amend Attachment "A" of the agreements as needed.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Page 1 of 3
   PARKS AND RECREATION COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, MAY 21, 2026
  2800 N. STUDEBAKER ROAD
  DR. THOMAS J. CLARK COMMUNITY CENTER, 9:00 AM

5.  26-55053  Recommendation to authorize the Director of Parks, Recreation and Marine to
  execute a new the Right-of-Entry Permit with Long Beach Heritage, a California
  nonprofit corporation, on behalf of Friends of Willow Springs Park, for a period of
  two years, from June 1, 2026, to May 31, 2028, with two (2) two-year renewals at
  the discretion of the Director of Parks, Recreation and Marine for the activation of
  Willow Springs Park through accessible programming, educational opportunities,
  and trail cleanup events. (District 5)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  26-55052  Recommendation to authorize the Director of Parks, Recreation and Marine to
  execute a Right-of-Entry Permit, and any other necessary documents, with the
  Belmont Heights Community Association, an unincorporated nonprofit association,
  to improve and maintain the Red Car Greenbelt for a period of two years from
  June 1, 2026, to May 31, 2028, with two (2) two-year renewal period at the
  discretion of the Director of Parks, Recreation and Marine. (District 3)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  26-54955  Recommendation to receive and file the monthly “Director’s Highlights” for May
  2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

8.  26-54956  Recommendation to discuss potential agenda items for future Parks and
  Recreation Commission meetings.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Parks and Recreation Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker
is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Christine Amaya, Administrative Aide, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours
prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Parks, Recreation and Marine Administration
Office at (562) 570-3170.

If oral language interpretation for non-English speaking persons is desired or if a special
accommodation is desired pursuant to the Americans with Disabilities Act, please make your request

kung nais ang isang natatanging tulong ayon sa Americans with Disabilities Act, mangyaring
isagawa ang iyong hiling sa pamamagitan ng telepono sa Opisina ng Clerk ng Lungsod sa (562)
570-6101, 24 oras ng negosyo bago ang pagpupulong ng Charter Commission.

Si desea interpretación oral en otro idioma para personas que no hablan inglés o si desea una
adaptación especial en conformidad con la Ley de Estadounidenses con Discapacidades, haga su

antes de la reunión de la comisión de estatutos.

If written language translation of the Commission agenda and minutes for non-English speaking
persons is desired, please make your request by phone to the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 570-

pagpupulong ng Commission.

Si desea obtener la traducción escrita en otro idioma de la agenda y actas de la comisión para
